metadata.description: Word's split bold runs do not reach the rendered output as literal asterisks.
metadata.regression_of: 2026-09-25: Word stores 'Engineering & Technology' as three runs when the ampersand was typed separately, and pandoc is faithful to that, emitting `**Engineering ****&**** Technology**`. Markdown reads the empty `****` as literal text. 57 of them reached the corpus inside the master resume and retrieval was matching against text with asterisks in it for four days before anyone looked.
